definitions.explanation: The money a business makes after its costs are paid. A term of economics and business writing.

examples.japanese: {利潤|りじゅん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{上|あ}げる→上げる：02443_ageru⟧。
⟦{企業|きぎょう}→企業：00225_kigyou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{利潤|りじゅん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{追求|ついきゅう}→追求：14401_tsuikyuu⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。

⟦{原材料|げんざいりょう}→原材料：18966_genzairyou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{値上|ねあ}がり→値上がり：11538_neagari⟧で、⟦{商品|しょうひん}→商品：01436_shouhin⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{売|う}れて→売れる：02012_ureru⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧{利潤|りじゅん}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦ほとんど→ほとんど：00847_hotondo⟧⟦{残|のこ}らない→残る：01187_nokoru⟧。
examples.english: With raw materials getting more expensive, there's hardly any profit even when the products sell.

notes:
More technical than ⟦{利益|りえき}→利益：03673_rieki⟧; common in economics (the profit motive, profit rates).
